properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 740411
Incident Time: 2004-11-04 12:30:00
Nearest City: Atlanta Airport, GA
Incident Type: MOBILE
Material: PAPER INK ( CONTAINS COPPER, LESS THAN 1%)
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: DELTA AIRLINES
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 55 gallons
A CARGO TRUCK WAS DELIVERING CARGO TO DELTA'S AIR LOGISTICS FACILITY. THE CARGO HAD NOT BEEN FULLY SECURED, AND ROLLED OUT OF THE TRUCK. UPON HITTING THE GROUND, THE DRUM DEVELOPED A LARGE CRACK, AND RAPIDLY LOST ITS CONTENTS.COUNTERMEASURES WERE DEPLOYED, BUT HEAVY RAINFALL IN THE AREA ALLOWED SOME MATERIAL TO ENTER THE STORM DRAINS, CONNECTED TO THE FLINT RIVER. THE MATERIAL CONTAINS BETWEEN .1% AND 1% COPPER. AN MSDS IS AVAILABLE UPON REQUESTS.

Medium Affected: WATER
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 43.085873, -78.948201 (Approximated from premise)
Report DescriptionTHE CALLER STATED THAT WHILE CONDUCTING EXCAVATION FOR A POOL AT THE LOCATION VARIOUS MATERIALS WERE UNEARTHED. THE MATERIALS IN QUESTION HAVE RELEASED INTO SOIL AND GROUND WATER AT THE LOCATION. BECAUSE OF THIS THE RESIDENCE AT THE LOCATION HAS BEEN ADVERSELY AFFECTED. THE SOURCE OF THE RELEASE IS UNKNOWN, HOWEVER THE CALLER SUSPECTS THE LOVE CANAL SUPERFUND SITE, WHICH IS (300) FEET FROM THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE CALLER ALSO SUSPECTS A SECONDARY DUMP SITE THAT WAS DISCOVERED AT THE INCIDENT LOCATION TO BE A SOURCE OF THE RELEASED MATERIALS. THE AMOUNT OF MATERIAL THAT RELEASED IS UNKNOWN, HOWEVER THE CALLER STATED THAT THE DEC FILLED A 30-FOOT DUMPSTER OF AFFECTED SOIL. THE CALLER STATED THAT SAMPLES OF THE LOCATION HAVE BEEN TAKEN FROM THE INCIDENT LOCATION. THE SAMPLES HAVE BEEN TAKEN FROM MULTIPLE DIFFERENT LOCATIONS AT THE SITE. WHILE REMOVING THE AFFECTED SOIL A CONTRACTOR RESPONDED AND PLACED HEAVY DUTY GARDENING FABRIC TO THE LOCATION. DURING THE PROCESS SAND SOIL AND P-TILE HAVE ALSO BEEN APPLIED TO THE LOCATION. AFTER SEVERAL RAIN EVENTS AT THE LOCATION THIS REMEDIAL ACTION SEEMED TO FAIL.

properties.content:

Location2: COMMERCIAL FLIGHT FROM CHICAGO TO PORTLAND, OR
Incident Type: AIRCRAFT
Material: LITHIUM
Medium Affected: AIR
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 42.848709, -106.298082 (Approximated from locality)
Report DescriptionCALLER STATES A PASSENGERS LAPTOP WAS HOT AND STARTED SMOKING INSIDE THE CABIN OF A COMMERCIAL AIRPLANE. THE AIRCRAFT WAS FLYING FROM CHICAGO (ORD) TO PORTLAND OREGON (PDX). THE AIRCRAFT DIVERTED TO CASPER WYOMING (CPR) IN ORDER TO GET THE LAPTOP OFF OF THE AIRCRAFT. AN ELDERLY PASSENGER SUFFERED FROM SMOKE INHALATION AND WAS MET BY EMS AND TRANSFERRED TO THE HOSPITAL. THE SMOKE FROM THE LAPTOP WAS VERY THICK AND FILLED THE FORWARD HALF OF THE AIRCRAFT INTO THE FLIGHT DECK. THE LAPTOP WAS PLACED INTO A THERMAL CONTAINMENT BAG AND THEN PLACED IN THE AFT LABORATORY. THE LAPTOP WAS PLUGGED IN WHEN THE FIRE STARTED.

properties.summary: Incident Type: STORAGE TANK - NRC Report ID: 847910 - Medium Affected: OTHER - Suspected Responsible Party: GOODYEAR
properties.content:
NRC Report ID: 847910
Incident Time: 2007-08-31 23:30:00
Nearest City: Lawton, OK
Incident Type: STORAGE TANK
Material: SULFURIC ACID
Medium Affected: OTHER
Suspected Responsible Party: GOODYEAR
Skytruth Analysis
Reported Spill Volume: 2580 gallons
///UPDATE TO NRC REPORT #847829/// CALLER REPORTED THAT A LEAK IN A TANK RELEASED 2580 GALLONS OF SULFURIC ACID INTO SECONDARY CONTAINMENT. WHILE THIS WAS IN SECONDARY CONTAINMENT, AN UNKNOWN AMOUNT TRAVELED BEYOND THE CONTAINMENT AREA AND IMPACTED NEARBY SOIL. ANOTHER UNKNOWN AMOUNT ENTERED A BASEMENT BELOW THE PUMP ROOM. THE PRODUCT IN THE BASEMENT STARTED REACTING SO AN EMPLOYEE SPRAYED WATER ON THE SPILL TO STOP THE REACTION. DURING CLEAN UP EFFORTS, THEY WERE ABLE TO RECOVER 1700 GALLONS OF SULFURIC ACID AND THEY ARE GUESSING THAT THE REMAINING MATERIAL ENDED UP IN THE SOIL AND IN THE BASEMENT.
